M1_recovery_never_attempted._note: The pre-fix behaviour: a no-base conflict goes to the merge layer with base undefined.

M8_recovered_base_dropped._note: The recovery runs but its base never reaches the merge — the warning would claim a recovery that did not happen.

M9_rename_recovered_at_old_path._note: Without the same-path guard a remote rename (same uid, other path) recovers a base at the OLD path and writes the renamed content there (reviewer probe PA).

M10_no_fair_share._note: Each conflict may spend the whole remaining pass budget: two expensive unrecoverable conflicts first starve the cheap phantoms after them (reviewer probe PG).

M11_skipped_conflict_not_reported._note: A conflict skipped because the pass budget is already spent stays silent (reviewer LOW: boundary case). H10 reddens too: after a rate limit the second conflict is skipped by this same branch, so its warning counts one conflict instead of two.

M12_probe_through_backoff._note: Probes through the backoff transport wait out the rate limit and spend the per-sync wait budget the push needs (reviewer probe PH).
